remarks: Investor opportunity in the heart of Downtown Stamford! This well-maintained 1BR/1BTH residence on the 16th floor offers immediate rental income with long-term tenants in place through December 2026. Major updates include new HVAC and hot water heater (2023), with assessments fully paid, offering peace of mind. The Biltmore is a premier full-service condo in Downtown Stamford offering a 24-hour concierge, fitness center, community room, on-site laundry, shuttle to the train, landscaped courtyard, and more. Pet-friendly with garage parking ($118/mo) and storage available. Prime location near highways, Metro-North, UCONN, dining, shopping, vibrant Bedford Street and directly across from Pickleball America. Enjoy amazing city views and stunning sunsets from this elevated 16th-floor residence!
